dx_raw:
DIAGNOS:
Bilateral dorsomedial pontine and left thalamic infarction (paramedian basilar artery branch occlusion) causing bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia and see-saw nystagmus

**Alternatives considered:**

1. Wallenberg syndrome variant with crossedINO - though head impulse test was normal and no vestibular signs favoring lateral medullary involvement

2. Multiple sclerosis with bilateral MLF plaques - less likely given sudden onset and confirmed infarction on MRI

3. Paramedian midbrain infarction causing see-saw nystagmus - though MRI specifically localized to pons and thalamus rather than midbrain tegmentum
